value.rationale: Known exact stationary densities and Gaussian weak-reset limits do not quantify exponentially rare stationary excursions as multiplicative resets become ineffective. The explicit universal rate connects quadratic core fluctuations to a linear rare-tail regime at a physically natural inverse-log-contraction scale, with an exact intercept and a proof valid for both signs of the reset factor. This is a motivated limiting theorem for a studied stochastic-transport model rather than a renamed parameter or isolated numerical slice.
